# action-tag-ref: workflow steps that pin an action to a release tag `vN[.N[.N]]`, or to a major
# release branch such as `release/v1`. a tag names a release, it does not authorise access, and the
# owner, repository and path must still read as names; the commit-digest pin in commit-sha-pin.txt
# stays the stronger form.
# known gap: a repository name of four short words plus a suffix is reported, because the chunk
# guard keeps such a name for recall: `owner/four-short-words-toolchain@v1`.
